behavior.title: General Behavior
behavior.desc: Configure the polling refresh frequency for quota.

data.title: Data & History
data.autoCleanupDesc: To avoid disk bloat, the local SQLite database retains only the last 30 days of quota snapshots; expired rows are pruned automatically after the first update each day.
data.clearHistoryDesc: Delete all locally saved history snapshots. The exhaustion prediction model will reset and start learning again.
data.dialogTitle: Are you sure you want to clear prediction history?
data.dialogDesc: This will delete all locally stored quota percentage snapshots. The exhaustion rate prediction model will reset to "Analyzing consumption rate..." until 3 new snapshots are collected. This action cannot be undone.

security.title: Credentials & Security
security.envReadDesc: Sensitive keys are read from shell environment variables first (e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN). Only dynamic tokens such as OAuth device codes are cached in memory at runtime. The local SQLite database only contains display names, enabled status, and non-sensitive region settings.
security.noRelay: No External Relay or Plaintext Leak
security.noRelayDesc: Last Token never uploads your API keys to any external server. All API usage requests are sent directly from your local client to the corresponding service provider.

oneClickImport.title: One-Click Import Credentials
oneClickImport.desc: Detect local official CLI config files and current environment variables, and automatically import all available API keys and account credentials.

cli.codexGuide: Attempts to read config file ~/.codex/auth.json (chatgpt/OAuth mode required)

manual.emptyDesc: Click "Auto-Discover" above to batch-detect providers from environment variables (e.g. MOONSHOT_API_KEY / KIMI_API_KEY / MINIMAX_API_KEY); or add a provider manually.

form.githubDomainDesc: Enterprise GHES instances need a complete host domain. Defaults to github.com.
